title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in managing Facebook Ads and Google Ads for US based ecommerce brands.Must have a portfolio of work that demonstrates the results that you have been able to provide and the KPIs you have hit. Must also demonstrate your skills with creative testing through media buying on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok ads.Responsibilities Manage the Meta, Google, and/or TikTok ad accounts of US based ecommerce brands Run ad campaigns across Meta, Google, and TikTok Monitor ROAS, ad budgets, revenue, and core KPIs to optimize campaigns and achieve the desired results for our clients Run profitable creative testing campaigns and identify trends to be able to communicate with the client what is working and what we should be creating more of Create performance marketing reports for the accounts that you are managing to accurately display the analytics, results, and next steps Strategize on ways to improve the overall marketing strategy for our brands to increase effectiveness Maintain awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competitive landscape, and market trendsQualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field OR 3-4 years of experience OR alternative education experience (mentors or courses) Prior experience working for an ecommerce brand or advertising agency is preferred Must be proficient in Facebook & Google Ads management for ecommerce brands Must be proficient in scaling ad budgets Strong communication, conceptual thinking, and a hunger to always provide great results for our clients Autonomous worker with an analytical mind Portfolio of work, results, or case studies You should be comfortable using some internal communication tools such as Monday.Com, Google Drive, Zoom, and Slack for team meetings and to support other team members with any technical request. title: Engenheiro(A) De Ia Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa: O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.Sobre a Oportunidade: Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes. Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.Principais Responsabilidades: Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.Requisitos e Qualificações: Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
Arquiteturas de agentesautônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.Você vai se divertir mais se: Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.Será um diferencial se você: Tiver experiência com Node.Js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
Já tiver trabalhado comRAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
Possuir experiência comAWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.Nossos benefícios: Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;
Vale Transporte;
Plano de Saúde Ambulatorial (Unimed) + Plano Odontológico (Uniodonto);
Wellhub (Gympass) — acesso a academias, estúdios e atividades físicas;
️ Guia da Alma — plataforma de terapia online e bem-estar emocional, com diversos profissionais de saúde mental;
Auxílio-Creche;
Seguro de Vida;
️ Conexão Premiada — programa de incentivo por indicação de talentos;
Ambiente inspirador, com foco em desenvolvimento e alta performance!Vaga 100% remota.Venha fazer parte do nosso Time!

This role requires strong English communication, experience working directly with US stakeholders, and the ability to manage high-volume recruiting across multiple requisitions.Key Responsibilities: Manage full lifecycle recruiting (intake → sourcing → screening → submission → interview → offer → close) Support US-based hiring managers and account teams Handle high-volume req loads (20–40+ open roles depending on complexity) Recruit across technical and/or professional roles Work within ATS/VMS systems (including high-touch / low-touch / no-touch environments) Maintain strong pipeline activity and candidate engagement Ensure high-quality submissions with strong attention to detailRequirements: 7+ years recruiting experience (agency or staffing strongly preferred) Proven experience supporting US-based clients Strong English (spoken + written) Experience with high-volume recruiting environments Experience working with VMS / MSP models Highly process-driven and organized Supporting customers in the US EST TimezoneNice to Have: Experience supporting Government or strict compliance accounts Technical recruiting experience (IT, cloud, DevOps, etc.) Metrics-driven mindset (submittals, interviews, placements)

title: Senior Content Manager
description: As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media's growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.This role contributes directly to the CORE department's objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.To be more specific, you will:Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.The ideal profileWe're looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.You are someone who:Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must) Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus) Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing itYou bring strong CM fundamentals:High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills Ownership mindset over site and content performance Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals Experience working with CMS platformsYou work well with others and think ahead:Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potentialFeeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.Next steps in the process 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role's requirements 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!What's in it for youA full time remote work environment. A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results, not hours. Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path. Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun. We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!MoveUp MediaWe're a dynamic and driven team that's all about growth. Partnering with top-notch brands in the exciting worlds of iGaming and sports, we're on a mission to connect sports fans to global advertisers. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. And here's the best part: we're a 100% remote team that thrives on efficiency and flexibility. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Our approachWe focus on people. We put end users' experience as a priority on all strategies and processes. Thus, we aim to make complex topics easy to understand and provide exactly what our audience is seeking. We achieve this by carefully analyzing data and reflecting upon it, writing the content with care, and ensuring a smooth user experience.Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all individuals, regardless of their background, race, gender, sexual orientation, or abilities. We celebrate the unique perspectives and talents that each person brings to the table, and we strive to create a welcoming and supportive environment where everyone can thrive and succeed. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce leads to greater teamwork and success. Join us in our journey towards a more inclusive and equitable future! Note: If you have any more questions or need further assistance for specific arrangements linked to your recruitment process, feel free to contact

title: Quality Assurance (Qa) — Funcional / Manual
description: Estamos buscando profissionais de QA para atuação em qualidade ponta a ponta, com foco em validação funcional, evidências e rastreabilidade das entregas em um ecossistema com microserviços, integrações e múltiplos meios de pagamento.Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.Responsabilidades: Planejar, executar e evidenciar testes funcionais ponta a ponta, garantindo aderência às regras de negócio. Criar e manter cenários/casos de teste e evidências com rastreabilidade em Jira/Xray (preferencialmente com Gherkin quando aplicável). Participar de refinamentos, entendimento de regras e definição de critérios de aceite. Executar testes de regressão, testes exploratórios e suporte a UAT/homologação. Validar integrações e fluxos críticos envolvendo APIs, microserviços, mensageria (SQS), ERP e meios de pagamento (Pix/Boleto/Cartão). Acompanhar incidentes/bugs, priorização e retestes junto aos times de desenvolvimento e produto. Garantir rastreabilidade entre requisito teste evidência defeito (Jira/Xray).Conhecimentos obrigatórios: Experiência com testes funcionais e processos de qualidade em ambientes ágeis. Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e integrações (APIs/microserviços). Capacidade de validar APIs com ferramentas como Postman/Insomnia (validação de payload, status code e regra). Vivência com Jira e ferramenta de gestão de testes (ex.: Xray). Boa escrita de cenários, critérios de aceite e documentação de evidências. Experiência com regressão e priorização de cenários críticos.Habilidades Desejáveis: Noções de observabilidade (Dynatrace/Loki) para apoio à triagem e evidências. Experiência com jornadas de Checkout e Pagamentos (Pix, boleto, cartão) e fluxos correlatos. Noções de segurança/controles (ex.: PCI) do ponto de vista de testes (cuidados com dados sensíveis e evidências). Conhecimento básico de ambientes cloud/AWS e dinâmica de múltiplos ambientes (multi-account).A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: Staff Ai Engineer | Ai Orchestration & Sdlc Automation
description:
Seu talento impulsiona o nosso futuroAGetneté uma empresa global de tecnologia especializada em soluções de pagamento para o comércio. Fundada no Brasil e presente na América Latina e na Península Ibérica, apoiamos mais de1,3 milhão de comerciantescom serviços completos — da maquininha ao e-commerce. Fazemos parte daPagoNxt, a fintech global do Grupo Santander, e atuamos como um hub de adquirência com forte presença emEspanha, Portugal, Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai. Nossa missão é clara:simplificar os pagamentos com inovação, segurança e escala, ajudando negócios de todos os tamanhos a crescer com agilidade. Oferecemos uma plataforma unificada que integra hardware, software, prevenção à fraude, adquirência, conciliação e serviços financeiros — tudo em um só ecossistema, para que nossos clientes possam focar no crescimento do seu negócio. Fazer parte da Getnet é se juntar a uma empresa que combina a inovação de uma fintech com a solidez de um banco global. Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey. Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza. Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro. Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem. Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo. Já te imagina sendo Nxter?Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Staff AI Engineer | AI Orchestration & SDLC Automation para se juntar ao nosso time no Brasil (Porto Alegre/RS ou São Paulo/RS)O que você vai fazer Estamos buscando uma pessoa que irá atuar como Staff-level Engineer para projetar e gerenciar uma camada de orquestração de IA incorporada em nossos pipelines de CI/CD, transformando a IA em uma capacidade de engenharia de software controlada e escalável. Essa função é responsável por institucionalizar agentes de IA (começando com Devin), automatizando o ciclo de vida do software de ponta a ponta, preservando a propriedade e a responsabilidade humanas.AI Orchestration & Architecture: Projetar e implementar uma camada de orquestração de IA integrada ao pipeline de CI/CD. Orquestrar agentes e habilidades de IA em todas as etapas do SDLC (design, desenvolvimento, teste, refatoração). Definir como as sessões de IA são criadas, gerenciadas, versionadas, auditadas e revisadas.Context Engineering at Scale: Projetar mecanismos para provisionar automaticamente o contexto por projeto, incluindo: Bases de código Arquitetura e documentação Padrões e políticas Histórico de tickets e incidentes Garantir que a IA opere com um contexto preciso, delimitado e em conformidade desde o primeiro dia.SDLC Automation & Ticket Flow Automatize fluxos de trabalho a partir de tickets do Jira: Ingestão e classificação de tickets Criação automática de sessões de IA Vinculação de contexto e definição do escopo da tarefa Ciclos de revisão e aprovação humana Habilite a rastreabilidade de ticket → código → testes → implantação.CI/CD Integration Incorpore a orquestração de IA em pipelines de CI/CD para: Geração e modificação de código Geração e manutenção automatizadas de testes Revisões de PR e verificações de qualidade Verificações de conformidade e segurança Garanta que os resultados da IA sejam governados, repetíveis e mensuráveis.Devin Deployment & Scaling
- Liderar a implementação inicial do Devin em toda a organização.
- Definir padrões de uso, diretrizes e modelos de adoção.
- Garantir que o Devin evolua de uma ferramenta para uma capacidade de engenharia padronizada.Measurement & Governance Definir métricas para medir o impacto da IA na produtividade, qualidade e confiabilidade. Garantir que toda a atividade de IA seja observável, auditável e alinhada com a governança corporativa. Aprimorar continuamente a orquestração com base em resultados e feedback.Technical Leadership Atuar como responsável técnico pela IA dentro do SDLC (Ciclo de Vida de Desenvolvimento de Software). Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, DevOps, QA (Garantia da Qualidade), Segurança e Arquitetura. Orientar engenheiros seniores e definir as melhores práticas. O que buscamos em você
- Sólida experiência profissional em engenharia de software.
- Liderança técnica comprovada em nível de equipe/principal.
- Sólida experiência em engenharia de plataforma, CI/CD e ferramentas internas.
- Experiência na construção de sistemas de orquestração de fluxo de trabalho.
- Experiência prática na integração de agentes de IA ou LLMs em pipelines de produção.
- Experiência em ambientes regulamentados de grande escala.
- Experiência em desenvolvimento. Required skills Platform & Orchestration
- Sistemas distribuídos e orquestração de fluxos de trabalho
- Design de pipelines CI/CD
- APIs, SDKs e frameworks de automação
- Observabilidade e auditabilidadeApplied AI
- Modelos de Aprendizagem Baseados em Lógica (LLMs), orquestração de agentes, chamada de ferramentas

title: Ai Engineer
description:
Must Haves 1+ year of experience as an AI/ML Engineer 2+ years of Python or Java development experience, including API development, model training, testing, and general backend engineering Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ingestion workflows, or ETL processes Experience evaluating the quality of Search or Generative AI systems Strong communication skills;
able to work independently while providing clear, consistent updates to the team Collaborative team player who is proactive in sharing knowledge and contributing to team best practicesPlusses Familiarity with AWS infrastructure (IAM, VPC, S3, etc.) Experience using LangChain to build LLM workflows with tools, memory, and retrieval Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or other Lucene-based search technologies Experience with Airflow Exposure to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecturesDay to Day We are hiring two AI/LLM Engineers (one Mid-Level and one Senior) to join a cross-functional team of engineers, data scientists, and quality engineers. In this role, you will contribute to an enterprise-grade, end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. The role includes deploying code to non-production environments and supporting production releases in collaboration with the DevOps team. This is primarily a hands-on individual contributor role, with an expectation of clear communication, collaboration, and active participation in team discussions and planning.

title: Partner Strategy & Management Manager
description:

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure. This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments. We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.Why this role exists We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support. We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well. Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.TL;
DR You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to: Lead cloud migrations to OCI Design cloud architectures Automate migrations and infrastructure Coordinate DevOps engineers Talk directly to clients Help build repeatable DevOps processes You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients. English is a plus, not required.This is not a ticket-based DevOps job If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you. This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:\ "We can automate 80% of this.\" And then actually build the automation.What you'll actually do Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.Cloud Migrations A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI. Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.Automation We want to automate everything that can be automated: Automated infrastructure provisioning Migration scripts CI/CD pipelines Environment replication Monitoring setups If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.Client Discussions You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.Leading DevOps Engineers As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.What we're looking for You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems. You likely: Love automating infrastructure Hate manual processes Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems Are comfortable debugging production environments Enjoy designing architectures Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.Technical Expectations Cloud Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important AWS Azure GCPDevOps Docker Kubernetes Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools CI/CD pipelines Linux systems administration Networking fundamentals Automation Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.Languages Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.Why work with Quave We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software. Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy. Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).Pay and Benefits This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience. Fully remote work Flexible hours 22 days paid time off per year Quarterly bonus based on company performance AI allowance for productivity tools We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.Hiring Process Application review Technical conversation Architecture discussion Conversation(s) with one or more partners This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

description:

- 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.
- Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.
- Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.
- Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.
- Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.
- Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.
- Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.
- Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.
- Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.
- Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.
- Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.
- Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP. Preferred Skills:
- Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.
- Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.
- Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.
- Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance. Leadership Skills:
- Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.
- Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.
- Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Quality Engineer (Qe) — Automação- Sênior

serviços/microserviços). * Especificar e implementar cenários seguindo BDD com Gherkin. * Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Xray (Gherkin). * Garantir cobertura e eficácia com técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca. * Integrar automação aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins), garantindo execução recorrente e confiável. * Realizar smoke testing e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas. * Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) quando aplicável. * Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações para qualidade ponta a ponta. * Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes de teste e execução de pipelines automatizados. * Apoiar investigação de falhas utilizando observabilidade (traces/métricas/logs), quando necessário.O que esperamos de você: * Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação). * Experiência com Gherkin (BDD) e uso do Xray com Gherkin. * Profundo entendimento de APIs (validação de payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, etc.). * Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins). * Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados. * Familiaridade com testes em ambientes distribuídos / microserviços. * Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca. * Vivência com smoke testing. * Programação (principalmente JavaScript) — obrigatório e eliminatório.Desejável: * Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e tópicos de mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento). * Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting básico de execuções (logs/health checks). * Experiência com observabilidade (Dynatrace / OpenTelemetry / Grafana Loki) para diagnóstico e redução de testes instáveis ("flaky tests"). * Experiência com testes de performance e segurança. * Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP). * Noções de Terraform (para entendimento de ambientes e limitações de infraestrutura).A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. title: Professor De Inglês
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!AIdioma Independente, referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*O que oferecemos?Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo auma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeosde treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .Necessário:Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company:Fraud DeflectRole:Data AnalystLanguage:Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.About the role Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.Responsibilities Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets. Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking. Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation. Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities. Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics. Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data. Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data. Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed. Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data. Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way. Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow;
ClickHouse is a plus).Required Strong MySQL/SQL skills. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving. Experience building dashboards and reports. Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis. Experience working with production data and validating data quality. Python proficiency for analysis or automation. Strong communication and troubleshooting skills. Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.Nice to have Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data. Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools. AWS experience. Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting). Prior ClickHouse experience. Basic Linux/CLI comfort.How to apply Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Immigration Attorney (Us-Licensed)
description: About the job POSITION SPECIFICATION Position Title: Immigration Attorney(US license is required) Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil) The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMSABOUT US HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.POSITION SUMMARY As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include: Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client's unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings. Case Management and Strategy Development:Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively. Preparation and Submission of Cases:Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports. Collaboration and Team Leadership:Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework. Response to Legal Queries:Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses. Appeals and Legal Motions:Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND J.D. from an ABA-approved law school. Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law. An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s. Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters. Fluency in a second language is desirable. Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities. Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.APPLICATION PROCEDURES Start Date: Immediate. Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM. Location: Remote. Compensation & Benifits: -Competitive salary -Home office allowance -Health insurance (after probation period) -Dental plan -CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible. Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to, referencing\ "Immigration Attorney position".

Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and intervene early when needed.Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product development team. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.JOB SKILLS:Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global environment.Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS' product valueLanguage Skills This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil;
fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand their needs and exceed their expectations.Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS' value through storytelling and analytical insights.Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones) Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support Reports to:CTO / VP EngineeringAboutDeep.BI We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.Role Overview As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.Key Responsibilities Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4):Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions) Performance optimization:Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load. Architecture & design support:Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches. Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA:Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes. CVE patching:Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments. Knowledge sharing:Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed. Optional / nice-to-have: Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation) Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.Requirements 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production(not just querying or dashboard usage;
no PoCs) Proven experience withquery optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines. Solid knowledge ofdistributed systems concepts(consistency, replication, failover, scaling) Hands-on experience withhigh availability and disaster recovery setups Comfort withLinux systems, networking basics and SQL. Ability toanalyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure(incident scenarios) Strong English language communication skills— able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing Bonus:Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM). Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.What we offer Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies atenterprise scale. Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities. Competitive salary Support for conference travel and OSS contributions Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.Location & working style Remote‐first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones. Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Clinical Trial Associate Ii
description:
Clinical Trial Associate IIResumo da Posição O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.Principais Responsabilidades: - Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais. - Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil. - Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento. - Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs). - Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade. - Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações;
liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções. - Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros. - Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho. - Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.Qualificações - Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde. - Inglês Fluente - Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis;
experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória. - Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita;
confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos. - Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico. - Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. title: Support Specialist
description: At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. Our Nurture Marketing Platform has generated more than $1 billion in revenue for our customers since 2018. We do this by unleashing the power of direct-to-consumer brands' customer data to deliver perfectly personalized email and SMS marketing strategies that are proven to grow their revenue. And we're just getting started! We are well-funded, growing super fast, and building a beautiful product with crew members located around the US and in our Minneapolis Hub.Working at Drip means empowering the ecommerce rebellion alongside some of the best people in the biz. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more:  Ready to empower the rebellion? Join Drip!About the opportunity As a Support Specialist at Drip, you'll be part of our small, nimble team providing technical guidance and unparalleled support for our customers. Our world-first product is in the hands of global merchants, and our team is a critical piece in ensuring their success during usage. The specialist acts as the first point of contact for clients or users facing technical challenges and is expected to provide clear communication and effective solutions. The working hours for this position are 9:00am - 5:30pm US Central Time M-F. This is a full-time contractor engagement (PJ). You will be a fully integrated member of our global crew.We're engaging and collaborative as we resolve questions and help create customer-facing self-help resources. How do we do that?Key Responsibilities:Troubleshooting & Problem Solving Diagnose and resolve software and network-related issues. Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices. Identify root causes of issues and recommend solutions or escalate to higher-level support as needed. Customer Support Provide timely and effective customer service via email, chat, or video. Guide customers through problem-solving steps, explaining technical details in an understandable manner. Document customer issues and solutions in a ticketing system. Documentation & Reporting Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs. Report recurring technical issues to management or product development teams to address underlying problems. Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem. Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip Passion for helping others internally and externally Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Software Engineer

monitor performance anditerate based on feedback. CI/CD pipelines Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuningWhat We're Looking For Strong problem‐solving skills and a data‐driven mindset. Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs. Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support. Excellent collaboration with cross‐functional partners and stakeholders.Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

You enjoy designing scalable, privacy-compliant architectures that enable reliable data collection, attribution, and measurement across complex digital ecosystems. You take ownership of architectural decisions, think in systems, and balance technical rigor with business impact. You are comfortable operating across marketing, analytics, and engineering teams, translating complex technical concepts into clear guidance, and defining standards that improve data quality, performance, and long-term maintainability.You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies: 5+ years of experience in application architecture, marketing technology, or analytics engineering roles. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong working knowledge ofReact, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to implement and debug complex tracking solutions. Advanced proficiency with Google Tag Manager, including custom JavaScript variables and structured data layer implementations. Strong experience implementing and governing Google Analytics 4, including event modeling and advanced tracking strategies. Hands-on experience with Facebook Business Manager, Facebook Pixel, and Conversions API. Solid understanding of Google Ads conversion tracking and remarketing integrations. Proven experience designing client-side and server-side tracking architectures. Strong understanding of privacy regulations, Consent Mode, and browser restrictions (ITP) and their impact on data collection. Experience using browser developer tools and tag debugging extensions. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities: Architect and implement a modular, scalable application architecture for marketing data collection and digital analytics. Own and optimize advanced Google Tag Manager configurations, including tags, triggers, variables, and structured data layers. Govern tracking implementations across Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Facebook Pixel, including Conversions API integrations. Design tracking solutions resilient to browser privacy restrictions and compliant with global privacy regulations. Lead the transition from fragmented client-side tracking to robust server-side and API-driven architectures when appropriate. Troubleshoot and resolve complex, production-level tracking and performance issues affecting data accuracy or site stability. Conduct regular audits to ensure data accuracy, attribution integrity, and alignment with business and marketing objectives. Collaborate closely with marketing, analytics, and engineering teams to document requirements and implement new tracking solutions. Optimize tracking implementations to protect and improve Core Web Vitals and overall site performance. Develop and maintain technical documentation and architecture standards related to tracking, performance, and system reliability.Qualifications 5+ years of experience in application architecture or marketing technology roles. 5+ years of experience with React. Advanced experience with Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4. Strong experience with Facebook Pixel and Conversions API. Solid JavaScript knowledge for tracking implementations.Additional Information About UsAtApplaudo, we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with anAI-native mindsetat the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values:Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication.These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description: Manager, Corporate DevelopmentPerseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.Com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.Location:BrazilThe Role: The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.G. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus' acquisition of software companies.The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.Outcomes: Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s). Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs. Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency. Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals. Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.Relevant Experience & Competencies: At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles. A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing. Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered. Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals. Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours. Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.Other Requirements: This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

Engenharia de Especificação: Atuar no modelo Spec-Driven Development (SDD). Ler o PRD, criar/refinar a Spec técnica e garantir que a implementação siga estritamente o contrato definido, utilizando IA para geração e validação de código. Agentes Autônomos: Desenvolver ou integrar\ "Agent Skills\" dentro do app, permitindo que o usuário interaja com agentes capazes de executar tarefas complexas (ex: buscar dados, agendar, analisar). Qualidade: Garantir performance, acessibilidade e testes automatizados, validando o código gerado por IA.Requisitos React Native: Domínio avançado (Hooks, Performance, Native Modules, Reanimated). TypeScript: Tipagem estrita e avançada. Ecossistema de IA: Experiência prática com Cursor IDE (Composer, Chat, Rules). Conhecimento de MCP (Model Context Protocol) para conexão de dados e ferramentas. Familiaridade com conceitos de AI Agents e Orquestração (LangChain, Vercel AI SDK ou similar). Metodologia: Vivência com Spec-Driven Development ou trabalho orientado a contratos de interface/API. Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
Fluência em inglês;
Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).Requisitos desejáveis:Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo: (CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).O que oferecemos?
