title: Data Scientist - Sênior (Motor De Busca)
description: No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?Buscamos uma pessoa Cientista de Dados para atuar na squad de Busca, com foco em Busca Semântica, relevância e ranking. Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução da experiência de busca, atuando desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, experimentação e mensuração de impacto, com forte interface com Produto, Engenharia e Negócio.Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e evoluir soluções de Busca Semântica utilizando Elasticsearch, indo além da busca lexical tradicional. Atuar na definição e otimização de: Estrutura de índices e mappings Estratégias de ranking híbrido (lexical + semântico) Queries semânticas (ex: embeddings, similarity search, boosting contextual) Trabalhar com vetorização de conteúdo (produtos, termos de busca, atributos) para melhoria de relevância. Avaliar e evoluir métricas de qualidade de busca. Conduzir testes A/B e experimentos controlados para validar impacto das melhorias semânticas. Traduzir problemas de negócio e experiência do usuário em soluções analíticas e modelos de dados. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia e Produto na definição do roadmap técnico de busca. Garantir boas práticas de ciência de dados: versionamento, documentação, reprodutibilidade e monitoramento. Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time, elevando o nível das discussões técnicas.Requisitos necessários Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas afins. Experiência comprovada de 5 a 7 anos em projetos de ciência de dados. Experiência prática com Busca Semântica em Elasticsearch Experiência com Information Retrieval (IR) e conceitos de relevância. Conhecimento em NLP aplicado à busca (ex: embeddings, similaridade textual). Experiência com modelos de ranking ou learning to rank. Domínio de SQL para análise de grandes volumes de dados. liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções. - Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros. - Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho. - Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.Qualificações - Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde. - Inglês Fluente - Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis;
experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória. - Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita;
confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos. - Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico. - Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Business Development Manager (Bdm) - Forex Brokerage
description: Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company's expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.About the CompanyA regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth. Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.Client & Partner Management Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners. Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions. Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.Market & Industry Intelligence Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings. Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives. Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Deep interest in financial markets and trading products. Strong negotiation and closing skills. Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset. Excellent communication and presentation abilities. Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.What We Offer: Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission. Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients. Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment. Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.How to Apply: If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we'd love to hear from you

title: Especialista Em Infraestrutura Azure

Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS) - Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos - Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering Azure Files - Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup Azure Networking – Conceitos principais - Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP - Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall - Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute - Private Endpoints e service endpoints - Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações - Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking - Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher - Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros - Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede Logs e análises - Integração com Log Analytics Workspace - Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL) - Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura - Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais Backup, recuperação e resiliência Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios - Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files - Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault - Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração - Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres - Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware) - Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade - Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos - Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde Segurança, governança e conformidade - Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking - Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito - Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC - Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags - Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretasAutomação e integração (desejável): - Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep - Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps - Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) - Runbooks operacionais padronizados Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente - Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica - description:

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, BrazilPOSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer's technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP's, support FRISS' implementation teams & other potential duties.DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:Customer Relationship Management Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on expectations and needs.Proactive Engagement Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.Performance Monitoring Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and intervene early when needed.Product Enhancements Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the customer.Renewals and Upselling Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.Customer Training Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.Internal Collaboration Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.JOB SKILLS:Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global environment.Must Haves: Insurance Expertise Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS' product valueLanguage Skills This role requires tri-lingual language skills: Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil;
fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.Nice to Haves: Customer Focus and Engagement You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand their needs and exceed their expectations.Business & Analytical Insights You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS' value through storytelling and analytical insights.Technical Proficiency You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Ecommerce Growth Marketing Paid Media Specialist

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:

- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value

- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users
- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals
- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products
- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground upHow We Work Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.What You'll Get

- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration
- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges
- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;

Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
Domínio em automação detestes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:

Implementar e evoluir aplataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo deOTB (Open to Buy)e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda. Conexão com o Mercado;
Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
Eficiência Operacional;
Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.Responsabilidades Definir e liderar avisão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial, alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
Gerenciar aevolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning, garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
Atuar comobraço tecnológico do time comercial, conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;

Garantir aarquitetura eintegridade dos dados de produto, do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;

Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio deKPIs claros e orientados a impacto .Escopo Tecnológico Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares: PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros. Conhecimento profundo dociclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
Experiência atuando comsistemas corporativos e integrações(ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
Forte capacidade analítica, com uso dedados para tomada de decisão ;
Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
Experiência commetodologias ágeis ;
Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade emnegociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .Diferenciais Desejáveis Experiência prévia comSAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
Conhecimento emOTB (Open to Buy), planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
Domínio deSQL, Power BIou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
Experiência em decisõesdeBuild vs. Buye gestão de fornecedores de software;
Atuação em ambientes detransformação digital de áreas comerciais .O que define sucesso nessa posição Redução do lead timedo ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
Alta taxa de adoçãodas ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
Crescimento dopercentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Ui/Ux Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior LevelAbout the Role We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.We are looking for aUI/UX Designerwho can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.What You'll Do
- Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff
- Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions
- Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration
- Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements
- Contribute to and help maintain shared design systems across multiple products
- Present design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership
- Collaborate with product managers to define success metrics for design decisions and evaluate outcomes after launch What We're Looking ForMust-Have Experience
- 3+ years of product design experience, ideally within a startup, consultancy, or fast-paced product environment
- Strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking and problem solving, not just visual design
- Advanced proficiency withFigmaincluding components, auto-layout, variables, and interactive prototyping
- Experience designing for both web and mobile platforms with awareness of technical constraints
- Ability to communicate design decisions in terms of user impact and business value
- Comfortable working in ambiguous environments where problems are not fully definedNice to Have
- Experience designing products for enterprise or B2B users
- Familiarity with front-end development concepts such as HTML, CSS, or React fundamentals
- Experience with service design or end-to-end journey mapping for complex products
- Experience building or scaling a design system from the ground upHow We Work Our teams operate in short delivery cycles with tight collaboration between design, product, and engineering. We prioritize fast decision making, direct communication, and high ownership.We partner with organizations across industries including healthcare, financial services, logistics, and enterprise software. Projects range from building new products from scratch to modernizing complex legacy platforms.What You'll Get
- Competitive base salary with performance-based compensation
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
- Flexible remote-first environment with optional in-person collaboration
- Exposure to a wide range of industries and product challenges
- A design-focused team that values craft and pushes each other to produce exceptional work

title: L3 Support Services Appendix Redhat
description:
L3 Support Services Appendix REDHAT Type: Contract Location: Columbia/ Argentina/ Brazil (We are only considering candidates from the following countries) Rate: DOEJob Summary: Objective: Responsible for the performance, availability, and reliability of our cloud-based services and underlying infrastructure, acting as a critical technical subject matter expert. Key Details:
- Skills: Linux (mandatory) with experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack
- Experience: 7–10 years
- Interview Process: 2 rounds
- Requirements: Immediate
- Candidate has to work in CST OR EST timeKey Responsibilities: ● Manage, troubleshoot, and optimize containerized applications and infrastructure deployed on Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, and OpenStack platforms. ● Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for core cloud infrastructure technologies, including advanced Linux (CentOS) system administration, Docker/Containers, and complex networking configurations. ● Lead the investigation and resolution of complex, high-severity customer issues, applying strong analytical knowledge to quickly diagnose problems across the entire cloud stack. ● Utilize your expertise to quickly identify root causes and implement effective, durable solutions for customer incidents. ● Prepare and conduct rigorous Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical incidents to identify systemic issues and prevent recurrence. ● Develop, test, and maintain robust automation scripts using Python and Ansible to streamline daily operational tasks and improve overall service efficiency. ● Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort in maintenance and deployment activities. ● Provide end-to-end Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency (EME) support, acting as a final escalation point to ensure service availability and meet SLAs. ● Liaise directly with the customer team and internal teams to understand requirements and deliver tailored technical solutions. ● Stay current with industry best practices and emerging technologies in cloud and containerization. Scheduling: ● Our team operates on a follow-the-sun model, ensuring 24/7 coverage and rapid response times. While this may occasionally require shifts outside typical local business hours, the total work hours will remain consistent with a standard work week. ● A rotational on-call schedule is a mandatory part of this position. On-call experts are responsible for providing immediate support for urgent cases, including direct customer contact (via call/Teams) and prompt engagement in designated war rooms for case investigation and resolution. ● All interventions are performed in live environments and must strictly follow the Standard Network Touch Policy, requiring full awareness and compliance during urgent case resolution. Required Skills & Qualifications:● Linux Expertise: Strong knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Linux administration. ● Networking Foundations: Strong knowledge of core networking principles (TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment. ● Containerization & Virtualization: Strong knowledge of Kubernetes orchestration, OpenStack platforms, and Docker/Containerization. ● Problem-Solving Mindset: Possess sharp troubleshooting skills combined with an analytical mindset to dissect and address complex challenges. ● Scripting and Automation: Solid Python scripting skills for task automation and system management. ● Configuration Management: Hands-on experience with Ansible for configuration management.' ● Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Expertise in preparation and implementation of RCAs. ● Escalation and Monitoring: Proven experience with EME (Escalation, Monitoring, and Emergency) management processes. Preferred Qualifications: One or more certifications from the list below will be considered an added advantage: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Cloud Infrastructure (EX210), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE) in Red Hat OpenStack (EX310), RHCSA, RHCE, CKA, EX280 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration), EX380 (Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Automation and API Management). Communication & Attitude:● Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) and the ability to articulate complex issues clearly. ● Demonstrated ability to handle customer pressure and manage expectations with a positive, professional attitude. ● Strong team player, self-motivated, and capable of excelling in a high-pressure, dynamic support environment.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce DeveloperImportant Information Location:Brazil Job Mode:Full-time Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryWe are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).Responsibilities and DutiesLead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.Essential SkillsExperience with Salesforce development;
Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista De Sistemas Sênior
description:
Quem Somos A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants. Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.O que esperar de nós Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco? Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.Nosso Cliente Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho Estamos procurando um Analista de Sistemas com grande capacidade de comunicação e espírito investigativo para se juntar à nossa equipe de TI. Este profissional dará suporte e implementará aplicativos de laboratório, ferramentas de controle estatístico, integrações e serviços em nuvem. O candidato ideal deve ser hábil em conduzir sessões de descoberta com equipes de negócios, analisar problemas de ponta a ponta e traduzir as necessidades de negócios em soluções práticas e técnicas. Responsabilidades:
- Liderar atividades de descoberta para compreender processos de negócios, necessidades dos usuários e requisitos do sistema.
- Realizar investigações aprofundadas e análises de causa raiz para questões técnicas e funcionais.
- Atuar como ponte de comunicação fundamental entre equipes de negócios, usuários finais e TI.
- Implementar, configurar e dar suporte a aplicativos de laboratório (LIMS, automação de software de integração, ferramentas de QC/QA, plataformas de revisão de dados).
- Dar suporte a ferramentas de controle estatístico e qualidade analítica (monitoramento de dados, painéis de qualidade).
- Configurar e manter serviços do Azure, incluindo App Services, Storage, SQL e API Management (APIM).
- Compreender arquiteturas de servidor e realizar configurações no nível do aplicativo.
- Documentar processos, requisitos e decisões técnicas de maneira clara e estruturada.
- Colaborar com equipes globais de TI e fornecedores externos em melhorias e integrações de sistemas.
- Participar de testes de aceitação do usuário, validação e sessões de treinamento.O que você precisa ter
- Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.
- Certificações em Azure ou experiência equivalente são um diferencial.
- Experiência prévia em ambientes de laboratório, qualidade ou manufatura é uma vantagem.Habilidades Técnicas
- Experiência com aplicativos de laboratório e sistemas de CQ/CQ.
- Conhecimento de estatística ou controle estatístico de processos (CEP).
- Experiência com serviços do Azure (App Services, Storage, APIM, SQL).
- Sólida compreensão de APIs, integrações e fluxos de dados.
- Familiaridade com ambientes de servidor e conceitos básicos de redes.
- Conhecimento de SQL (consultas, solução de problemas, compreensão de esquemas). Habilidades interpessoais
- Excelentes habilidades de comunicação (verbal e escrita).
- Forte mentalidade investigativa e analítica.
- Capacidade de traduzir detalhes técnicos em linguagem acessível aos negócios.
- À vontade para conduzir workshops, sessões de requisitos e entrevistas com usuários.
- Fortes habilidades organizacionais e de multitarefa.Onde você vai trabalhar No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime100% Home Office, com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations. Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions. Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policiesgoverning margin lending and virtual asset collateral Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor riskindicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board. Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations. Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters. Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies. Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.Requirements: Legally resident in Brazil. Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years)in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms. Demonstratedindependence from commercial functionsand ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge ofCentral Bank of Brazilrisk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets. Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
postgraduate qualification preferred. Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
fluency inPortuguese and English. Must meetfit and properstandards withno disqualifying factors, including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised. not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description: About Us BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we're looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.What You'll Do As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.More specifically, in this role you will: Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs) Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updatesWhat We're Looking For 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta) 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients) Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationshipsWhat This Role Is NOT This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.Time Commitment Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.Pay $3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.If you're passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCPCompensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

title: Clinical Trial Associate Ii
description:
Clinical Trial Associate IIResumo da Posição O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.Principais Responsabilidades: - Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais. - Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil. - Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento. - Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs). - Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade. - Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações;
liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções. - Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros. - Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho. - Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.Qualificações - Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde. - Inglês Fluente - Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis;
experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória. - Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita;
confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos. - Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico. - Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.Contratação no regime PJ, posição remota com disponibilidade para viagens internacionais conforme necessidade.

title: Starrocks Database Engineer (Dbe) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones) Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support Reports to:CTO / VP EngineeringAboutDeep.BI We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‐source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‐critical, high‐volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We're a small, world-class expert, remote‐first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.Role Overview As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You'll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful.Key Responsibilities Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4):Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions) Performance optimization:Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load. Architecture & design support:Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches. Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA:Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes. title: Founding Qa / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, Ai + Data Systems)
description: Job Description We're a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.We're rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure. Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.We're building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we're now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.We're looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.The Role As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will: - Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs - Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch - Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes - Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable - Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs - Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality - Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hiresWhat You'll Own - End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output - Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems - API integration testing and validation of external data flows - Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences - CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack - Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scaleWho Are You? - You've tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing) - Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter - You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps - You've built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch - Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications - Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented - Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others missTechnical Skills - Python (pytest or similar) - Playwright or Cypress - CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar) - Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systemsBonus: - Experience testing LLM or AI systems - Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks - Experience with document processing or OCR systems - Experience working in insurance or insurtech environmentsCulture & Expectations This is an intense, output-driven environment. We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders. We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it. High ownership. High accountability. High standards. We don't care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability. We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.Logistics - Quarterly trips to NYC for collaborationCompensation Competitive salary Meaningful equity Leadership path fully uncapped for the right personWho This Is Ideal For A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.Why Join Now? You'd be joining at the exact moment when: - The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders - Two successful companies have already been built in this domain - The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned - The market is at a breaking point and demanding change - The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcomeIf you're hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren't many chances to be this early on something this big.

description: Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.Client & Partner Management Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners. Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.What We Are Looking For: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field. 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives). Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Deep interest in financial markets and trading products. Strong negotiation and closing skills. Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset. Excellent communication and presentation abilities. Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.What We Offer: Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission. title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description: Hey, Dingus!Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!About UsDingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an "unlimited get-shit-done" subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.Purpose of This PositionAs a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand's voice, positioning, and intent. You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.Core ResponsibilityServe as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad's clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions: "Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?"\ "Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?"Main Objectives1. Content Execution & Copywriting Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for: -Websites -Social media captions and post copy -Email campaigns -Campaign and promotional assets Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text) Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad. Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness. Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.2. Strategy & Project Management Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring: -Consistency in writing style -Variety in content types -A range of related, engaging topics3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand's voice and messaging. When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms. When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans. Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives. Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints. Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative. Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.5. Brand Advocacy Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content. Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution. Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand's intent.Reporting Relationship This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand's voice, tone, and messaging. Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity. Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand's voice, positioning, and goals. Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.2. Content Quality & Accuracy Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose. Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.3. Project Delivery Timeliness Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines. Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Requires a working level of written and spoken EnglishReady for the ride of your life? Apply now!

Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade. Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua. Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As aSoftware Engineer, you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.Responsibilities
- Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.
- Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.
- Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review
- Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)
- Support production deployments
- Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.
- Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery
- Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.
- Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development
- Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.
- Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.
- Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification
- Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks
- Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software
- Effective verbal and written communication
- Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly
- Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed
- Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results
- Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work
- Parse, analyze and understand system log files
- Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels
- Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation
- Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills
- Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates
- Migration of platforms and application components.
- Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotationQualifications
- Technologist, Bachelor's or Master's Degree
- At least 7 years of Software Development experience
- Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.G. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)
- Java 17+
- Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)
- In memory caching like Hazelcast
- Oracle 12c
- XML, JSON
- Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA
- REST Services
- API Management frameworks
- General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle
- Jenkins, Sonar
- JIRA & Confluence
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues
- Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Analista De Crédito E Cobrança Pleno
description:
